enabled.description: Whether the Keycloak realm provisioning Job should be installed.

nameOverride.description: String to partially override the generated fullname.

fullnameOverride.description: String to fully override the generated fullname.

url.description: Base URL of the Keycloak instance to configure. Defaults to the in-cluster service.

loginRealm.description: The realm to authenticate the admin user against.

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing Secret (in this release's namespace) holding the admin credentials.

usernameKey.description: Key within the existing Secret that holds the admin username.

passwordKey.description: Key within the existing Secret that holds the admin password.

tag.description: Image tag. Adorsys publishes only Keycloak-suffixed tags (e.g. "6.5.1-26" or "6.5.1-26.1.0"); set to match the target Keycloak version.

imagePullSecrets.description: Secrets for pulling the image from a private registry.

varSubstitution.description: Enable variable substitution (e.g. $(env:VAR)) within realm files. The bundled core.json relies on this; every referenced variable must be supplied via configCli.extraEnv.

enabled.description: Wait for Keycloak to be reachable before importing.

timeout.description: How long to wait for Keycloak availability.

logLevel.description: Optional log level for keycloak-config-cli (e.g. info, debug). Empty uses the image default.

extraEnv.description: Additional environment variables to pass to the container.

useHelmHooks.description: Run the Job as a post-install/post-upgrade Helm hook so realms are reconciled on every release.

backoffLimit.description: Number of retries before the Job is considered failed.

activeDeadlineSeconds.description: Maximum duration the Job may run before being terminated.

restartPolicy.description: Pod restart policy for the Job.

annotations.description: Additional annotations to add to the Job.

labels.description: Additional labels to add to the Job.

create.description: Whether to create a ServiceAccount for the Job.

name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount to use. Generated from the fullname when empty.

podAnnotations.description: Additional annotations for the Job pod.

podLabels.description: Additional labels for the Job pod.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level security context for the Job pod.

securityContext.description: Container-level security context for the keycloak-config-cli container.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the container.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for scheduling the Job pod.

tolerations.description: Tolerations for scheduling the Job pod.

affinity.description: Affinity rules for scheduling the Job pod.
